trap.label: pronome repetido
trap.wrong: She is the writer who she wrote this book.
trap.right: She is the writer who wrote this book.
trap.why: Em português dizemos “a escritora que ela escreveu”, e o brasileiro repete o pronome. Em inglês, who/that já é o sujeito da oração relativa; não se repete.

mcq.q: The man **___** car was stolen called the police.
mcq.why: Posse (o carro DO homem) pede whose.

mcq.q: The book **___** I bought is great.

opts: The woman who she lives next door is kind.
The woman lives who next door is kind.
The woman who lives next door is kind.
mcq.why: Who já é o sujeito; não há “she”.

mcq.q: I like the novel **___** won the prize.
mcq.why: Novel é coisa: that/which; who é só para pessoas.

fix.wrong: The film that I saw it was long.
fix.right: The film that I saw was long.
fix.why: O pronome relativo já substitui o objeto; não repita “it”.

fix.wrong: She is a reader who’s life changed.
fix.right: She is a reader whose life changed.

fix.wrong: This is the town where I was born in.
fix.right: This is the town where I was born.
fix.why: Where já inclui a preposição in.

rewrite.prompt: Una as frases com who: “I met a woman. She writes novels.”
rewrite.answer: I met a woman who writes novels.

rewrite.prompt: Una com that: “This is the book. I told you about it.”
rewrite.answer: This is the book that I told you about.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whose: “He is a boy. His mother is a nurse.”
rewrite.answer: He is a boy whose mother is a nurse.
